How to read this workup. Forecast = the analog cohort's P50 per 1,000 ft (deal-intake selection, same bench, nearest-first, lateral band, representative spacing; D57), scaled to the location's lateral (Cui & Cross efficiency below 7,500 ft, D50), then corrected by a stated walk-forward haircut (D62; BS2_S its own, D94 / D102; WCXY none, D97): on held-out ground this method historically overstated oil, and the factor below was applied. Volumes are uptime-free (D63): apply F(k) or a downtime factor, never both. Oil and gas only — no water in BOX v1 (D72). Technical forecast: no economic limit, EUR = raw 50-yr integral; no economics anywhere. Error convention: actual / forecast − 1 (negative = the method forecast HIGH).
